### Overall Assessment

This is an exceptional security review that combines outstanding persona work with technically accurate findings. The Roy Batty voice is perfectly executed—references to Tyrell Corporation, "tears in rain," inception dates, and existential observations are woven throughout while maintaining actionable technical content. The review correctly identified 10 of 12 expected vulnerabilities with accurate line numbers and provided solid fixes including the bcrypt recommendation. The two missed findings (timing attacks on string comparison and session fixation) are somewhat more subtle issues that would have elevated this to a near-perfect score.
